Canton of Zurich Financial Directorate Financial Administration Legal /-in - Business Process Manager /-in 80% The financial administration arranges the finances of the Canton of Zurich and provides an overall overview. On behalf of the Government Council, it draws up the budget with financial plan and the bill of the canton. It prepares financial decisions of the Government Council, ensures efficient accounting and provides appropriate services for the entire administration. The Hardship Programme implements the Covid-19 Hardship Programme of the Canton of Zurich to support the companies affected by the measures. This includes the definition and adaptation of processes and instruments for implementation, ex-post monitoring of terms and conditions including appeal proceedings, loan management including debt collection and reporting. The specialist office is responsible for the continuously digital application, examination and payment process implemented for the hardship program, which is used and expanded in the context of the digitization of administration for a large number of further case processing processes in the Canton of Zurich. Based on the practical experience gained during the implementation of the hardship programme, the Financial Administration was commissioned to further develop a uniform practice in the Canton of Zurich on application processes and on the allocation and management of state contributions. We are looking for reinforcement immediately or by agreement. Their tasks:
• Preparation and maintenance of documentation of legal bases, the systematics, processes and practice of awarding and managing state contributions in the Canton of Zurich
• Further develop methodology, processes and tools to harmonise the allocation and management of government contributions
• Development of the basis for systematic state contribution controlling
• Training and advice of administrative units on government contributions and participation in projects
• Creation and maintenance of an exchange platform on government contributions
• Further development of methodology, processes and instruments for digital application processes incl. Advising the administrative units and participating in selected external projects Your profile:
• Lawyer with experience in Business Process Management or Business Process Manager with legal experience
• Master’s degree in business/economics with additional knowledge in state and administrative law or political/legal sciences with additional economic knowledge or equivalent training
• Training and/or experience in the analysis and design of business processes (Business Process Analysis/Engineering/Management)
• Multiannual relevant professional experience in the field
• Negotiable language skills in German (verbal/written); Good French language skills are beneficial
• advanced IT skills; Experience with SAP (FI) and project management is an advantage
• Analytical, conceptual, self-responsible and quality-conscious working method with a reliable and considered personality
• Holistic view of the role of administration in the interaction of politics, economy and society
• Good editorial skills as well as appearance and network competence We offer:
• Design latitude with effect: This function offers the opportunity to actively shape changes and make a visible contribution with your own work.
• Flexible working hours and a modern workplace in the heart of Zurich create attractive conditions for everyday work
• Versatile and exciting topics in a motivated and committed team Interested? We look forward to your online application. Please note that we only accept and process applications received via the online tool. Your specific questions about the position are answered by Daniel Rentzsch (Head of the Hardship Program) on +41 43 259 47 46. For questions about the application process, please contact Julia Ernst (Recruiting Specialist) at Tel.-No: +41 43 259 35 19. Your new environment: Financial management

Kanton Zürich Finanzdirektion Finanzverwaltung Jurist/-in - Business Process Manager/-in 80% Die Finanzverwaltung ordnet die Finanzen des Kantons Zürich und ermöglicht den Gesamtüberblick. Sie erstellt im Auftrag des Regierungsrates das Budget mit Finanzplan und die Rechnung des Kantons. Sie bereitet finanzielle Entscheide des Regierungsrates vor, sorgt für ein leistungsfähiges Rechnungswesen und erbringt entsprechende Dienstleistungen für die gesamte Verwaltung. Die Fachstelle Härtefallprogramm setzt das Covid-19-Härtefallprogramm des Kantons Zürich zur Unterstützung der durch die Massnahmen betroffenen Unternehmen um. Hierzu gehören die Definition und Anpassung der Prozesse und Instrumente für die Umsetzung, nachträgliche Kontrolle der Auflagen und Bedingungen einschliesslich Rechtsmittelverfahren, die Darlehensbewirtschaftung inklusive Inkasso sowie das Reporting. Die Fachstelle verantwortet den für das Härtefallprogramm implementierten durchgehend digitalen Antrags-, Prüfungs- und Auszahlungsprozess, welcher im Rahmen der Digitalisierung der Verwaltung für eine Vielzahl weiterer Fallbearbeitungsprozesse im Kanton Zürich eingesetzt und weiter ausgebreitet wird. Aufbauend auf den praktischen Erfahrungen bei Vollzug des Härtefallprogramms wurde die Finanzverwaltung beauftragt, im Kanton Zürich eine einheitliche Praxis zu Gesuchsprozessen und zur Vergabe und Bewirtschaftung von Staatsbeiträgen weiterzuentwickeln. Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung suchen wir hierfür Verstärkung. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Erstellung und Pflege einer Dokumentation von Rechtsgrundlagen, zur Systematik, Prozessen und Praxis der Vergabe und Bewirtschaftung von Staatsbeiträgen im Kanton Zürich
• Weiterentwicklung von Methodik, Prozessen und Instrumenten zur Vereinheitlichung der Vergabe und Bewirtschaftung von Staatsbeiträgen
• Erarbeitung von Grundlagen für ein systematisches Staatsbeitragscontrolling
• Schulung und Beratung der Verwaltungseinheiten zu Staatsbeiträgen und Mitarbeit in Projekten
• Schaffung und Pflege einer Austauschplattform zu Staatsbeiträgen
• Weiterentwicklung von Methodik, Prozessen und Instrumenten für digitale Antragsprozesse inkl. Beratung der Verwaltungseinheiten und Mitarbeit in ausgewählten externen Projekten Ihr Profil:
• Jurist/-in mit Erfahrung im Business Process Management oder Business Process Manager/-in mit juristischer Erfahrung
• Abschluss auf Stufe Master im Bereich Betriebs-/Volkswirtschaftslehre mit zusätzlichen Kenntnissen im Staats- und Verwaltungsrecht oder Staats-/Rechtswissenschaften mit zusätzlichen ökonomischen Kenntnissen oder gleichwertige Ausbildung
• Ausbildung und/oder Erfahrung in der Analyse und Gestaltung von Geschäftsprozessen (Business Process Analysis/Engineering/Management)
• Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung in dem Bereich
• Verhandlungssichere Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch (mündlich/schriftlich); gute Sprachkenntnisse Französisch von Vorteil
• Fortgeschrittene IT-Kenntnisse; Erfahrungen mit SAP (FI) und Projektmanagement von Vorteil
• Analytische, konzeptionelle, eigenverantwortliche und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise mit einer zuverlässigen und überlegten Persönlichkeit
• Ganzheitlicher Blick für die Rolle der Verwaltung im Zusammenwirken von Politik, Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft
• Gute redaktionelle Fähigkeiten sowie Auftritts- und Netzwerkkompetenz Wir bieten:
• Gestaltungsspielraum mit Wirkung: In dieser Funktion bietet sich die Möglichkeit, aktiv Veränderungen mitzugestalten und mit der eigenen Arbeit einen sichtbaren Beitrag zu leisten
• Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie ein moderner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von Zürich schaffen attraktive Rahmenbedingungen für den Arbeitsalltag
• Vielseitige und spannende Themenfelder in einem motivierten und engagierten Team Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online–Bewerbung. Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir nur Bewerbungen akzeptieren und bearbeiten, welche über das Online-Tool eingehen. Ihre konkreten Fragen zur Position beantwortet Ihnen gerne Daniel Rentzsch (Leiter Fachstelle Härtefallprogramm) unter +41 43 259 47 46. Für Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess wenden Sie sich bitte an Julia Ernst (Recruiting Specialist) unter Tel.-Nr.: +41 43 259 35 19. Ihr neues Umfeld: Finanzverwaltung

Canton de Zurich Direction financière Administration financière Legal /-in - Business Process Manager /-in 80% L'administration financière organise les finances du canton de Zurich et donne un aperçu général. Au nom du Conseil gouvernemental, il établit le budget avec un plan financier et le projet de loi du canton. Il prépare les décisions financières du Conseil gouvernemental, assure une comptabilité efficace et fournit des services appropriés à l'ensemble de l'administration. Le Programme de lutte contre les difficultés met en œuvre le Programme de lutte contre les difficultés Covid-19 du canton de Zurich pour soutenir les entreprises touchées par les mesures. Cela comprend la définition et l'adaptation des processus et des instruments de mise en œuvre, le suivi a posteriori des modalités, y compris les procédures d'appel, la gestion des prêts, y compris le recouvrement de la dette et l'établissement de rapports. Le bureau spécialisé est responsable du processus de demande, d'examen et de paiement numérique continu mis en œuvre pour le programme de sujétion, qui est utilisé et élargi dans le contexte de la numérisation de l'administration pour un grand nombre de nouveaux processus de traitement de cas dans le canton de Zurich. Sur la base de l ' expérience pratique acquise lors de la mise en œuvre du programme d ' aide d ' urgence, l ' Administration financière a été chargée de développer une pratique uniforme dans le canton de Zurich en ce qui concerne les procédures de demande et l ' allocation et la gestion des contributions de l ' État. Nous cherchons des renforts immédiatement ou d'un commun accord. Leurs tâches :
• Préparation et tenue à jour de la documentation des bases juridiques, de la systématique, des processus et de la pratique d'attribution et de gestion des contributions de l'État dans le canton de Zurich
• Développer la méthodologie, les processus et les outils pour harmoniser la répartition et la gestion des contributions publiques
• Développement de la base pour le contrôle systématique des contributions de l'État
• Formation et conseils des unités administratives sur les contributions gouvernementales et la participation aux projets
• Création et maintien d'une plate-forme d'échange sur les contributions des gouvernements
• Développement de la méthodologie, des processus et des instruments pour les processus d'applications numériques, y compris : Conseiller les unités administratives et participer à certains projets externes Votre profil:
• Avocat ayant une expérience en gestion de processus opérationnels ou gestionnaire de processus opérationnels ayant une expérience juridique
• Maîtrise en commerce/économie avec des connaissances supplémentaires en droit administratif et d'État ou en sciences politiques/juridiques avec des connaissances économiques supplémentaires ou une formation équivalente
• Formation et/ou expérience dans l'analyse et la conception des processus opérationnels (analyse des processus opérationnels/ingénierie/gestion)
• Expérience professionnelle pertinente sur le terrain
• Compétences linguistiques négociables en allemand (verbal/écrit); Bonnes compétences linguistiques en français sont bénéfiques
• l'expérience avec SAP (FI) et la gestion de projet est un avantage
• Méthode de travail analytique, conceptuelle, auto-responsable et soucieuse de la qualité avec une personnalité fiable et considérée
• Une vision globale du rôle de l'administration dans l'interaction politique, économique et sociale
• Bonnes compétences éditoriales ainsi que l'apparence et la compétence en réseau Nous offrons:
• latitude de conception avec effet: Cette fonction offre la possibilité de façonner activement les changements et de faire une contribution visible avec votre propre travail.
• Des horaires flexibles et un lieu de travail moderne au cœur de Zurich créent des conditions attrayantes pour le travail quotidien
• Des sujets polyvalents et passionnants dans une équipe motivée et engagée Intéressé? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature en ligne. Veuillez noter que nous n'acceptons et ne traitons que les demandes reçues via l'outil en ligne. Daniel Rentzsch (chef du programme Hardship) répond à vos questions spécifiques au +41 43 259 47 46. Pour toute question concernant le processus de candidature, veuillez contacter Julia Ernst (Spécialiste du recrutement) au tél.: +41 43 259 35 19. Votre nouvel environnement: Gestion financière

Cantone dell'istruzione di Zurigo Ufficio per la gioventù e la carriera Impiegato in Istruzione (MAiA) Lavoro sociale, 60% Buono per la vita – questo è il nostro motto. L'Ufficio per la gioventù e la consulenza professionale (AJB) è responsabile per il benessere dei bambini e dei giovani, nonché per la consulenza professionale. Il nostro lavoro si concentra su bambini, giovani e famiglie. Lavoriamo per loro ogni giorno con un sacco di cuore e impegno. Il Kjz (Centro di Assistenza per Bambini e Giovani) è un centro di consulenza polivalente per famiglie, genitori, adolescenti, bambini e bambini e lavora sulla base della legge sull'assistenza ai bambini e ai giovani del Cantone di Zurigo. Vuoi lavorare per il bene dei bambini e dei giovani? Poi, come dipendente nella formazione (MAiA) nel campo del lavoro sociale e dei mandati nel kjz Rüti, si sarà in grado di lavorare il 1 gennaio. Settembre 2026 o con accordo parte della nostra squadra. Parallelamente alla vostra formazione in un'università di scienze applicate nel lavoro sociale, avrete l'opportunità di specializzarsi nel benessere dei bambini e dei giovani. Essi sono successivamente incorporati nella zona di attività. Il nostro core business include:
• Gestione dei casi di misure legali a nome dell'autorità per la protezione dei bambini e degli adulti KESB (assistenza e tutela)
• Consulenza per conto dei genitori
• Chiarificazioni in caso di rischi per il benessere dei bambini a nome dell'autorità per la protezione dei bambini e degli adulti KESB o dei tribunali Oltre ai compiti fondamentali e alla cooperazione con genitori, bambini e adolescenti, questo significa:
• Finanziamento e redazione di relazioni e richieste alle autorità
• Cooperazione con le case, famiglie adottive, supporto familiare socio-educativo, servizi psichiatrici per bambini e adolescenti, servizi psicologici scolastici, ecc.
• a seconda del mandato anche l'esecuzione dei compiti nell'ambito dell'amministrazione finanziaria Hai già iniziato con lo studio di base in un'università di scienze applicate nel lavoro sociale o portare l'ammissione per l'inizio degli studi. Stiamo affrontando una persona motivata, affidabile e resiliente con un alto livello di competenza sociale. Sono caratterizzati da un metodo di lavoro indipendente e da una buona capacità espressiva scritta e orale. Prima esperienza professionale e un'età minima di 25 anni sono richiesti. Vi offriamo una posizione di formazione attraente in un ambiente emozionante e un posto di lavoro centrale con infrastrutture moderne vicino alla stazione ferroviaria Rüti (1/4 ore al giorno da Zurigo-HB). Le condizioni di lavoro corrispondono agli orientamenti cantonali. Possiamo rispondere ad altre domande? Per ulteriori informazioni, si prega di contattare la signora Désirée Stebler, responsabile del lavoro sociale e del mandato, al telefono. No. 043 259 76 00 è disponibile. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione completa tramite strumento online alla signora Sandra Zahner, risorse umane, Hinwil, Meilen, Pfäffikon e Uster ufficio distrettuale a Wetzikon. Solo le domande presentate tramite la nostra piattaforma online possono essere elaborate.

Canton of Zurich Education Directorate Office for Youth and Career Advice Employee in Education (MAiA) Social Work, 60% Good for Life – that is our motto. The Office for Youth and Vocational Counselling (AJB) is responsible for child and youth welfare as well as professional counselling. Our work focuses on children, young people and families. We work for them every day with a lot of heart and commitment. The kjz (Child and Youth Assistance Centre) is a polyvalent counselling centre for families, parents, adolescents, children and toddlers and works on the basis of the Children and Youth Assistance Act of the Canton of Zurich. Do you want to work for the good of children and young people? Then, as an employee in training (MAiA) in the field of social work and mandates in the kjz Rüti, you will be able to work on 1 January. September 2026 or by arrangement part of our team. Parallel to your education at a university of applied sciences in social work, you will have the opportunity to specialize in child and youth welfare. They are successively incorporated into the task area. Our core business includes:
• Case management of legal measures on behalf of the child and adult protection authority KESB (assistance and guardianship)
• Counselling on behalf of parents
• Clarifications in case of child welfare risks on behalf of the child and adult protection authority KESB or the courts In addition to the core tasks and the cooperation with parents, children and adolescents, this means:
• Filing and drafting of reports and requests to authorities
• Cooperation with homes, foster families, socio-educational family support, child and adolescent psychiatric services, school psychological services, etc.
• depending on the mandate also the execution of tasks within the framework of financial administration You have already started with the basic study at a university of applied sciences in social work or bring the admission for the start of studies. We are addressing a motivated, reliable and resilient person with a high level of social competence. They are characterized by an independent working method as well as a good written and oral expressive ability. First professional experience and a minimum age of 25 years are required. We offer you an attractive training position in an exciting environment as well as a centrally located workplace with modern infrastructure next to the Rüti train station (1/4 hour every day from Zurich-HB). The employment conditions correspond to the cantonal guidelines. Can we answer any further questions? For further information, please contact Ms. Désirée Stebler, Head of Social Work and Mandate, at tel. No. 043 259 76 00 is available. Cantone di Zurigo Direzione finanziaria Human Resources Project Manager/-in apprendistato sviluppo Amministrazione cantonale 80 - 100% L'Ufficio del Personale del Cantone di Zurigo è responsabile di tutte le questioni di personale, occupazione e sicurezza sociale degli oltre 30.000 dipendenti del Cantone di Zurigo. Il reparto Gestione delle Risorse Umane (HRM) comprende un gran numero di compiti e fa parte dell'Ufficio Risorse Umane. Consulenza delle risorse umane, formazione professionale di base, marchio del datore di lavoro e gestione dei casi sono al centro del lavoro. L'istruzione professionale di base significa plasmare il futuro. Ogni anno, circa cento apprendisti in 25 apprendisti iniziano la loro formazione al Canton Zurigo. Dietro ogni apprendistato c'è l'opportunità di accompagnare i giovani nella loro vita lavorativa e allo stesso tempo di formare gli specialisti di domani. La formazione professionale di base presso l'Ufficio delle Risorse Umane insieme al Forum della formazione professionale è responsabile dell'orientamento strategico e dell'ulteriore sviluppo della formazione professionale nel Cantone di Zurigo - dalla definizione di standard e processi, dall'ulteriore sviluppo dell'offerta di apprendistato, nonché da progetti ed eventi comuni. Insieme, stiamo gettando le basi per il Cantone di Zurigo per espandere ulteriormente il suo ruolo di modello di ruolo nella formazione professionale e continuare a offrire prospettive interessanti per i giovani in futuro. Questa nuova funzione vi offre l'opportunità unica di sviluppare strategicamente la formazione professionale nell'amministrazione cantonale. Insieme sviluppiamo una strategia e concetti cross-direzionali, creiamo nuove prospettive e formiamo la promozione di giovani talenti dal più grande datore di lavoro nel cantone di Zurigo. Il post è limitato in tempo per un progetto fino alla fine del 2029. Come puoi essere coinvolto?
• Sviluppare strategie: Insieme con le direzioni e i dipartimenti, concetti e strategie (ad esempio la promozione dell'apprendistato, l'istituzione del SOG[AB4.1], si crea un ulteriore impiego di apprendisti, modelli di società di insegnamento e professionisti dell'insegnamento) per l'ulteriore sviluppo della formazione professionale nell'amministrazione cantonale.
• I progetti portano al successo: dall'idea alla roadmap all'implementazione, sei responsabile di progetti impegnativi e assicurati che i concetti diventino risultati concreti.
• Costruire reti: Lavori con diversi stakeholder attraverso le directory, consideri interessi diversi, soluzioni attuali
• Creare una base per il processo decisionale: le analisi, le tendenze e le raccomandazioni per l'azione costituiscono la base per le decisioni strategiche e per l'ulteriore sviluppo della formazione professionale.
• Vedrete opportunità per nuovi modelli di formazione, rafforzare le offerte esistenti e sviluppare soluzioni sostenibili in modo che il Cantone di Zurigo offre interessanti prospettive per i giovani in futuro. Chi sei?
• La formazione professionale ti ispira: Conosci la formazione professionale di base dalla tua esperienza professionale e vuoi formarla attivamente.
• Pensa in modo strategico. Realizzazione pratica: sviluppi concetti realizzabili e non perdere mai di vista l'implementazione.
• Collegare le persone: unire interessi diversi e convincere attraverso chiarezza, diplomazia e un aspetto sicuro – anche in un ambiente politico. Cosa ti offriamo?
• Definire il futuro: con il vostro lavoro, sviluppate la formazione professionale del più grande datore di lavoro nel cantone di Zurigo e lasciate un segno duraturo.
• Un sacco di spazio per la manovra: ci si può aspettare una nuova funzione con alta responsabilità personale, attori emozionanti e la possibilità di plasmare attivamente la formazione professionale.
• Condizioni di lavoro moderne: orari di lavoro flessibili, opportunità di ufficio, condizioni di lavoro attraenti e un posto di lavoro a pochi passi dalla stazione centrale di Zurigo offrono condizioni ottimali. E adesso? Abbiamo suscitato il vostro interesse? Allora applica ora. Non vediamo l'ora di incontrarti. Si prega di notare che elaboriamo solo applicazioni che vengono ricevute tramite il nostro strumento online. Non hai bisogno di una lettera di motivazione con noi. Invece, rispondere alle nostre domande nello strumento – così possiamo conoscere voi e la vostra motivazione ancora più specificamente. Per ulteriori informazioni, Florian Manz (Capo dell'istruzione di base professionale) è a vostra disposizione dal 10. Il 1 agosto è disponibile il +41 43 259 42 30. Il tuo nuovo ambiente? www.zh.ch/pa

Canton of Zurich Financial Directorate Human Resources Project Manager/-in apprenticeship development cantonal administration 80 - 100% The Personnel Office of the Canton of Zurich is responsible for all personnel, employment and social security issues of the more than 30,000 employees of the Canton of Zurich. The Human Resources Management (HRM) department includes a large number of tasks and is part of the Human Resources Office. HR consulting, basic vocational training, employer branding and case management are the focus of the work. Basic vocational education means shaping the future. Every year, around one hundred apprentices in 25 apprenticeships start their training at the Canton of Zurich. Behind every apprenticeship there is the opportunity to accompany young people on their way into working life and at the same time to train the specialists of tomorrow. The basic vocational training at the Human Resources Office together with the Vocational Training Forum is responsible for the strategic orientation and further development of vocational training in the Canton of Zurich - from the definition of standards and processes, the further development of the apprenticeship offer as well as joint projects and events. Together, we are laying the foundations for the Canton of Zurich to further expand its role as a role model in vocational training and continue to offer attractive prospects for young people in the future. This newly created function offers you the unique opportunity to strategically develop vocational training in cantonal administration. Together we develop a cross-directional strategy and concepts, create new perspectives and shape the promotion of young talent by the largest employer in the canton of Zurich. The post is limited in time for a project until the end of 2029. How can you get involved?
• Develop strategies: Together with the directorates and departments, concepts and strategies (e.g. apprenticeship promotion, establishment of the SOG[AB4.1], further employment of apprentices, teaching company models and teaching professionals) for the further development of vocational training in the cantonal administration are created.
• Projects lead to success: From the idea to the roadmap to implementation, you are responsible for challenging projects and ensure that concepts become concrete results.
• Build networks: You work with different stakeholders across directorates, consider different interests, present solutions
• Creating a basis for decision-making: Analyses, trends and your recommendations for action form the basis for strategic decisions and the further development of vocational training.
• You will see opportunities for new training models, strengthen existing offers and develop sustainable solutions so that the Canton of Zurich offers attractive prospects for young people in the future. Who are you?
• Vocational training inspires you: You know basic vocational training from your own professional experience and want to actively shape it.
• Think strategically. Practical implementation: You develop viable concepts and never lose sight of the implementation.
• Connect people: You bring different interests together and convince through clarity, diplomacy and a secure appearance – even in a political environment. What do we offer you?
• Shaping the future: With your work, you develop the vocational training of the largest employer in the canton of Zurich and leave a lasting mark.
• Plenty of room for manoeuvre: You can expect a newly created function with high personal responsibility, exciting stakeholders and the opportunity to actively shape vocational training.
• Modern working conditions: Flexible working hours, home office opportunities, attractive employment conditions and a workplace within walking distance to Zurich Central Station offer you optimal conditions. Kanton Zürich Finanzdirektion Personalamt Projektleiter/-in Lehrstellenentwicklung kantonale Verwaltung 80 - 100% Das Personalamt des Kantons Zürich ist zuständig für alle personal-, arbeits- und sozialversicherungsrechtlichen Fragen der über 30'000 Mitarbeitenden des Kantons Zürich. Die Abteilung Human Resources Management (HRM) beinhaltet eine grosse Anzahl an Aufgaben und ist Teil des Personalamts. HR-Beratung, Berufliche Grundbildung, Employer Branding und Case Management stehen im Mittelpunkt der Arbeit. Berufliche Grundbildung bedeutet Zukunft gestalten. Jedes Jahr starten rund hundert Lernende in 25 Lehrberufen ihre Ausbildung beim Kanton Zürich. Hinter jeder Lehrstelle steht die Chance, Jugendliche auf ihrem Weg ins Berufsleben zu begleiten und gleichzeitig die Fachkräfte von morgen auszubilden. Die Berufliche Grundbildung im Personalamt ist zusammen mit dem Berufsbildungsforum für die strategische Ausrichtung und Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung im Kanton Zürich zuständig - von der Definition von Standards und Prozessen, der Weiterentwicklung des Lehrstellenangebotes sowie gemeinsamen Projekten und Veranstaltungen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir die Grundlagen dafür, dass der Kanton Zürich seine Vorbildrolle in der Berufsbildung weiter ausbaut und auch künftig attraktive Perspektiven für junge Menschen bietet. Diese neu geschaffene Funktion bietet dir die einmalige Möglichkeit, die Berufsbildung in der kantonalen Verwaltung strategisch weiterzuentwickeln. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir eine direktionsübergreifende Strategie und Konzepte, schaffen neue Perspektiven und prägen die Nachwuchsförderung des grössten Arbeitgebers im Kanton Zürich. Die Stelle ist im Rahmen eines Projekts bis Ende 2029 befristet. Wie kannst du dich einbringen?
• Strategien entwickeln: Gemeinsam mit den Direktionen und Fachbereichen entstehen Konzepte und Strategien (u.a. Lehrstellenförderung, Aufbau der SOG, Weiterbeschäftigung von Lehrabgänger/innen, Lehrbetriebsverbundmodelle sowie Lehrberufsverantwortliche) für die Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung in der kantonalen Verwaltung.
• Projekte zum Erfolg führen: Von der Idee über die Roadmap bis zur Umsetzung verantwortest du anspruchsvolle Projekte und sorgst dafür, dass aus Konzepten konkrete Ergebnisse werden.
• Netzwerke aufbauen: Du arbeitest direktionsübergreifend mit verschiedenen Anspruchsgruppen zusammen, berücksichtigst unterschiedliche Interessen, präsentierst Lösungsansätze
• Entscheidungsgrundlagen schaffen: Analysen, Trends und deine Handlungsempfehlungen bilden die Basis für strategische Entscheide und die Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung.
• Berufsbildung weiterdenken: Du erkennst Chancen für neue Ausbildungsmodelle, stärkst bestehende Angebote und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen, damit der Kanton Zürich auch künftig attraktive Perspektiven für junge Menschen bietet. Wer bist du?
• Berufsbildung begeistert dich: Du kennst die berufliche Grundbildung aus eigener beruflicher Erfahrung und möchtest sie aktiv mitgestalten.
• Strategisch denken. Praktisch umsetzen: Du entwickelst tragfähige Konzepte und verlierst dabei nie die Umsetzung aus den Augen.

Canton of Zurich Directorate of Justice and Home Affairs Prisons and Reintegration Investigation Prisons Zurich Supervisor/in / Supervisor/in 80 - 100% Prison and Reintegration (JuWe) is responsible as part of the Directorate of Justice and Home Affairs of the Canton of Zurich for the execution of penalties and measures as well as the execution of the various types of detention. For our 1,400 employees from around 40 professions, the successful social reintegration of people who have committed crimes and the prevention of recidivism are of particular importance. The Zurich Prisons of Detention (UGZ) – one of eight main departments of JuWe – currently operates seven prisons for pre-trial and security detention. Around 300 employees look after more than 700 detainees. The Horgen prison offers 51 seats and is run as a department of the Limmattal prison. To complement our team in Horgen Prison, we are looking for a committed, cosmopolitan and humorous personality by immediate or by agreement. Your tasks
• You will accompany, assist and employ detained persons during their pre-trial detention from entry to exit, taking on tasks in care, security and organisation
• You will meet imprisoned people and visitors professionally, respectfully and in a situational manner and act clearly and de-escalatingly even in demanding situations.
• You ensure an orderly daily routine, enforce safety and service regulations and manage crisis situations carefully
• Test at headquarters You ensure the safety of employees, detainees and third parties by operating security, surveillance and communications facilities as well as by triggering the security facility in emergencies
• You coordinate and supervise the visitation, receive gifts and ensure the necessary controls, including X-ray controls
• You take on administrative tasks such as reports and documentation and support the administration within the framework of detachment agencies, in particular dossier management, correspondence and the management of detainee accounts Your profile
• Meet people in a forced context You have a professional attitude, regulated proximity and distance, and the ability to detect crisis situations early and act de-escalating.
• You are motivated to actively participate in the development and design of prison conditions
• You are psychologically resilient and flexible for shift, night, weekend and holiday services
• You have technical understanding and pleasure in dealing with safety-relevant systems
• Completed commercial training (EFZ) or comparable and several years of professional experience, preferably in a comparable job
• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing; Knowledge of foreign languages is advantageous
• Able to deal with MS Office
• Minimum age of 25 years and an impeccable reputation (no relevant entries in the penal or enforcement register) Our offer

• A centrally located place of work with good connections to public transport

descriptionByLocale.it:

Area Edilizia C gestisce un portafoglio diversificato, tra cui università, scuole professionali e altri edifici educativi e amministrativi nel Cantone di Zurigo. A seconda dell'interesse e dell'esperienza, è anche possibile prendere su progetti più piccoli indipendentemente. Il tuo
• Parteciperai attivamente a una vasta gamma di progetti di costruzione e acquisirai informazioni su tutte le fasi di pianificazione, coordinamento e implementazione. Supporti la gestione del progetto in ambito organizzativo, tecnico e amministrativo
• Compiti e lavori a stretto contatto con architetti, progettisti specializzati, autorità e imprenditori. A seconda dell'interesse e dell'esperienza, è anche possibile condurre progetti più piccoli indipendentemente e assumersi la responsabilità. Lo stage è di solito rivolto a laureati di una laurea in architettura, ingegneria civile o una disciplina correlata – ma le eccezioni motivate sono benvenuti. Cerchiamo personalità impegnate, strutturate e comunicative con un interesse per la gestione del progetto, i processi di costruzione e la cooperazione interdisciplinare. Un lavoro pratico in un ambiente professionale con l'opportunità di acquisire una preziosa esperienza nella costruzione pubblica e di dare un contributo attivo a significativi progetti di costruzione del Cantone di Zurigo. Il vostro contatto Tomasz Soboczynski General Project Manager e Stv. Team Leader Team Team Team Team 2 Area di costruzione C 043 259 28 87 Cari fornitori di servizi HR! Purtroppo non possiamo tener conto dei dossier relativi alle tasse. Solo le applicazioni dirette saranno risolte e considerate nel processo di selezione. L'Ufficio Edilizia è responsabile per lo sviluppo, la realizzazione e la riparazione degli edifici cantonali, da Grossmünster all'edificio universitario. Assicura la pianificazione e la realizzazione competente di nuovi edifici, riparazioni e progetti di arte e costruzione di edifici pubblici. Si impegna per la sostenibilità e la cultura costruttiva, assicura un uso attento dei fondi e un alto livello di idoneità operativa. Se associate un'amministrazione complicata e polverosa con noi, vi sbagliate. Lavoriamo collegialmente, semplice e orientato alle prestazioni. L'orario di lavoro flessibile e il lavoro mobile sono altrettanto importante per noi come l'opportunità di svilupparvi professionalmente e personalmente.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The internship in the client representation at the Zurich Building Office offers you an exciting introduction to the world of public construction. Construction Area C manages a diverse portfolio, including universities, vocational colleges and other educational and administrative buildings in the Canton of Zurich. Depending on the interest and experience, it is also possible to take on smaller projects independently. Your
• You will actively participate in a wide range of building construction projects and gain insights into all phases of planning, coordination and implementation. You support the project management in organizational, technical and administrative
• Tasks and works closely with architects, specialist planners, authorities and entrepreneurs. Depending on the interest and experience, it is also possible to lead smaller projects independently and take on responsibility. The internship is usually aimed at graduates of a degree in architecture, civil engineering or a related discipline – but motivated exceptions are welcome. We are looking for committed, structured and communicative personalities with an interest in project management, construction processes and interdisciplinary cooperation. A practical job in a professional environment with the opportunity to gain valuable experience in public construction and to make an active contribution to significant construction projects of the Canton of Zurich. Your contact Tomasz Soboczynski General Project Manager and Stv. Team Leader Team 2 Construction area C 043 259 28 87 Dear HR service providers! Unfortunately, we cannot take account of dossiers relating to fees. Only direct applications will be answered and considered in the selection process. The Building Construction Office is responsible for the development, realization and repair of the cantonal buildings, from Grossmünster to the university building. It ensures competent planning and realization of new buildings, repairs and art and construction projects of public buildings. It is committed to sustainability and building culture, ensures careful use of the funds and a high level of operational suitability. If you associate a complicated, dusty administration with us, you are wrong. We work collegially, uncomplicated and performance-oriented. Flexible working hours and mobile work are just as much a matter of course for us as the opportunity to develop you professionally and personally.

Essa svolge un compito di Stato centrale e, in conformità al mandato giuridico, tiene conto della riabilitazione delle persone detenute e della tutela del pubblico generale. For our 1,400 employees from around 40 professions, the successful social reintegration of people who have committed crimes and the prevention of recidivism are of particular importance. The Pöschwies Prison (JVA) Pöschwies is one of eight main departments of JuWe and, with 399 seats, the largest closed JVA in Switzerland for delinquent men. It fulfils a central state task and, in accordance with the legal mandate, takes into account the rehabilitation of detained persons and the protection of the general public. In the field of economics and work, we are looking for a flexible, resilient and eager-to-learn personality with pronounced social competence and interest in the prison system. • Support of our work masters in versatile and varied activities in the work facilities

descriptionByLocale.it:
Cantone di Zurigo Direzione Giustizia e Prigione Interna Attuazione e Reintegrazione Pöschwies Senior Specialist/in Implementation Easings 60 - 80% Prison Implementation and Reintegration (JuWe) è responsabile come parte della Direzione di Giustizia e Interno del Cantone di Zurigo per l'esecuzione di sanzioni e misure, nonché l'attuazione dei vari tipi di detenzione. Per i nostri 1.400 dipendenti, la riuscita reintegrazione sociale di persone che hanno commesso crimini e la prevenzione della recidiva sono di particolare importanza. La prigione di Pöschwies (JVA) è uno degli otto reparti principali del JuWe. Con 399 posti a sedere, il JVA Pöschwies è il più grande carcere chiuso in Svizzera per gli uomini. Esegue un compito centrale dello Stato e, in conformità con il mandato giuridico, tiene conto della riabilitazione delle persone detenute e della protezione del pubblico generale. L'attuazione è un passo fondamentale nella transizione verso la libertà. Essi consentono alle persone incarcerate di assumersi gradualmente la responsabilità e di testarsi nella vita quotidiana al di fuori dell'istituzione. In questo modo, essi danno un importante contributo alla riabilitazione sociale, alla stabilizzazione e all'integrazione sociale. Per questa impegnativa funzione specialistica, stiamo cercando due personalità con esperienza (60 - 80% ciascuno) che condividono la responsabilità. In stretta collaborazione, si valutano questioni complesse, fanno valutazioni ben fondate e si sostengono a vicenda in scambio professionale. I tuoi compiti
• Valutazione indipendente delle domande di congedo e uscite nel carcere chiuso e aperto del JVA Pöschwies
• Preparazione di opinioni ben fondate e comprensibili sui rischi di volo, generale e di ricaduta come base per il processo decisionale per le autorità di gestione e di istruire
• Preparazione strutturata, precisa e indirizzabile di problematiche complesse

Canton of Zurich Directorate of Justice and Interior Prison Implementation and Reintegration Pöschwies Senior Specialist/in Implementation Easings 60 - 80% Prison Implementation and Reintegration (JuWe) is responsible as part of the Directorate of Justice and Interior of the Canton of Zurich for the execution of penalties and measures as well as the implementation of the various types of detention. For our 1,400 employees, the successful social reintegration of people who have committed crimes and the prevention of recidivism are of particular importance. The Pöschwies Prison (JVA) is one of eight main departments of the JuWe. With 399 seats, the JVA Pöschwies is the largest closed prison in Switzerland for men. It performs a central state task and, in accordance with the legal mandate, takes into account the rehabilitation of detained persons and the protection of the general public. Implementation easing is a key step in the transition back to freedom. They enable incarcerated persons to gradually assume responsibility and to test themselves in everyday life outside the institution. In this way, they make an important contribution to social rehabilitation, stabilization and social integration. For this demanding specialist function, we are looking for two experienced personalities (60 - 80% each) who share responsibility. In close cooperation, you assess complex questions, make well-founded assessments and support each other in professional exchange. Your tasks
• Independent assessment of applications for leave and exits in the closed and open prison of the JVA Pöschwies
• Preparation of well-founded and comprehensible opinions on flight, general and relapse risks as a basis for decision-making for the management and instructing authorities
• Structured, precise and addressable preparation of complex issues
• Ensuring compliance with obligations and conditions of granted easing of enforcement
• Close cooperation with the social service, management and external authorities in the context of implementation planning
• Participation in the further development of professional standards and support for training of accompanying persons in the area of leave and exit
• Continuous professional exchange with the second professional to jointly assess complex cases and ensure uniform decision-making
• Completed vocational training or higher education, preferably in the commercial or social sector
• At least 10 years of professional experience in a demanding administrative, social, security or regulatory environment
• Experience in the structured handling of complex cases as well as the ability to compose sound reports, assessments and summaries in a style-confident, precise and addressable manner
• Safe handling of digital work equipment and the common MS Office applications as well as enjoying actively shaping digitalization in everyday work
• High discretion, professionalism and an impeccable reputation (no entries in the enforcement or criminal record) Our offer
• Versatile and demanding work with high personal responsibility

• Meaningful task with varied challenges as well as diverse training opportunities

Für unsere 1'400 Mitarbeitenden sind die erfolgreiche soziale Wiedereingliederung von straffällig gewordenen Menschen und die Verhinderung von Rückfällen von besonderer Bedeutung. Die Justizvollzugsanstalt Pöschwies (JVA) ist eine von acht Hauptabteilungen des JuWe. Die JVA Pöschwies ist mit 399 Plätzen die grösste geschlossene Justizvollzugsanstalt der Schweiz für Männer. Sie erfüllt eine zentrale staatliche Aufgabe und trägt gemäss gesetzlichem Auftrag der Resozialisierung der inhaftierten Personen und dem Schutz der Allgemeinheit Rechnung. Vollzugslockerungen sind ein zentraler Schritt im Übergang zurück in die Freiheit. Sie ermöglichen inhaftierten Personen, schrittweise Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich im Alltag ausserhalb der Anstalt zu erproben. Damit leisten sie einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Resozialisierung, Stabilisierung und sozialen Integration. Für diese anspruchsvolle Fachfunktion suchen wir zwei erfahrene Persönlichkeiten (je 60 - 80%), die Verantwortung gemeinsam tragen. Pour nos 1 400 employés, la réussite de la réinsertion sociale des personnes qui ont commis des crimes et la prévention de la récidive revêtent une importance particulière. La prison de Pöschwies (JVA) est l'un des huit principaux départements du JuWe. Avec 399 sièges, la JVA Pöschwies est la plus grande prison fermée de Suisse pour hommes. Come stagista, vuoi contribuire a plasmare il futuro dell'Edifici Construction Office nel campo del BIM? Attualmente stiamo creando le basi necessarie presso l'Ufficio Edilizia per sostenere progetti di costruzione più grandi con il metodo BIM dal 2028 in poi. In questo stage, si lavora all'interfaccia di costruzione, BIM, dati, IT e l'organizzazione per garantire che BIM non solo funziona su carta. Se siete entusiasti di argomenti organizzativi e metodologici durante questa introduzione e strumenti digitali, allora siete nel posto giusto con noi. I tuoi compiti
• Sviluppare casi di uso di BIM (ad esempio CO2-Tracking & ReUse) e preparare, organizzare e post-process workshop
• Sostenere i progetti pilota BIM organizzativi e tecnici e monitorare i loro progressi

• Costruire il cockpit PowerBI per BIM@HBA e lavorare su un caso di test AI in relazione alla piattaforma di dati cantonali Lo porti con te.
• Studi completi in architettura, ingegneria civile, gestione delle costruzioni, costruzione digitale o un campo correlato - motivati concorrenti laterali con uno sfondo adatto sono anche benvenuti
• Prima conoscenza degli strumenti PowerBI, AI, programmazione o BIM
• La conoscenza di base dei cataloghi di dati specialistici, IDS e la modellazione strutturata dei dati BIM sono vantaggiose
• La comprensione di base per i processi di costruzione e le fasi SIA è un vantaggio
• Metodi di lavoro strutturati e indipendenti
• Gioia di comunicazione, collaborazione e nuovi argomenti Stai lavorando a un progetto di trasformazione con un impatto reale sul settore della costruzione e della pianificazione. Acquisirai informazioni su progetti di costruzione reali, processi client pubblici e argomenti attuali intorno a BIM, gestione dei dati e digitalizzazione. Potrai lavorare con clienti, portfolio manager, architetti, ingegneri e in grado di costruire rapidamente una rete preziosa come un giovane professionista. E infine, non devi essere in grado di fare tutto. Molto più importante è che siete curiosi, come pensare e godere di portare la struttura in argomenti complessi. Il tuo contatto Erik de Ruiter BIM Responsabile HBA +41 43 259 28 61 Lavora direttamente con Erik, che conduce l'introduzione del BIM presso l'Edificit Construction Office. La cooperazione è pragmatica, in rete, aperta e orientata all'attuazione. Il nostro obiettivo: costruire qualcosa di significativo insieme, provare cose nuove e divertirsi al lavoro. Assicura la pianificazione e la realizzazione competente di nuovi edifici, riparazioni e progetti di arte e costruzione di edifici pubblici. Come uno dei 15 centri per il benessere dei bambini e dei giovani nel Cantone di Zurigo, kjz Winterthur garantisce una fornitura uniforme, regionale e comunale solidamente sostenuta di servizi nei settori della consulenza giovanile e familiare, della consulenza genitoriale, della consulenza materna e paterna e della protezione dei bambini. Il kjz Winterthur offre agli studenti di psicologia (bachelor o master) in un'università svizzera o in un'università di sei mesi dal 1° febbraio 2027. Nell'ambito del tirocinio, si otterrà una panoramica delle seguenti attività:
• Partecipazione alle discussioni familiari da parte di vari psicologi nella consulenza genitoriale orientata al processo, orientata sistematicamente a nome dei genitori
• Consulenza e consulenza indipendente e sostegno di genitori, famiglie e assistenti con bambini e adolescenti fino a 18 anni in un quadro volontario
• Compiti amministrativi connessi con la causa (caratteristiche e corrispondenza relativa ai casi)
• Indagine sul lavoro di una valutazione della protezione dei bambini a nome del KESB sulle discussioni dei casi con i chiarificatori Avete l'opportunità di conoscere la vasta offerta di consigli genitoriali in kjz Winterthur e sono sistematicamente incorporati nei nostri compiti. Si può aspettare un'attività vivace e varia in un'istituzione dove si lavora insieme in modo interdisciplinare e in rete con altre aree dell'istituzione nel suo complesso. Le condizioni di lavoro corrispondono agli orientamenti cantonali. Abbiamo suscitato il vostro interesse? Allora non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione online. Mischa Frei, assistente pratica (tel. 043 259 94 48) è a vostra disposizione per domande. Ulteriori informazioni sono disponibili anche su www.ajb.zh.ch.

Canton of Zurich Education Directorate Office for Youth and Career Counselling Psychology Practitioner/in Education Counselling 60% The Office for Youth and Vocational Counselling of the Education Directorate provides, appoints, controls and coordinates offers of child and youth welfare and vocational counselling. As one of a total of 15 child and youth welfare centres in the Canton of Zurich, kjz Winterthur guarantees a uniform, regionally and municipally solidly supported provision of services in the areas of youth and family counselling, parental counselling, maternal and paternal counselling and child protection. The kjz Winterthur offers students of psychology (bachelor or master) at a Swiss university or university a six-month internship from 1 February 2027. As part of the internship, you will gain insight into the following activities:
• Participation in family discussions by various psychologists in process-oriented, systemically oriented parenting advice on behalf of parents
• Co-advice as well as independent advice and support of parents, families and caregivers with children and adolescents up to 18 years of age in a voluntary framework
• Case-related administrative tasks (file notes and case-related correspondence)
• Insight into the work of a child protection assessment on behalf of the KESB about case discussions with the clarifiers You have the opportunity to get to know the diverse offer of parental advice in kjz Winterthur and are systematically incorporated into our tasks. You can expect a lively, varied activity in an institution where you work together in an interdisciplinary and networked manner with other areas of the institution as a whole. The employment conditions correspond to the cantonal guidelines. Have we aroused your interest? Then we look forward to your online application. Mischa Frei, practice assistant (tel. 043 259 94 48) is at your disposal for questions. Further information can also be found at www.ajb.zh.ch.

Das kjz Winterthur gewährleistet als eines von insgesamt 15 Kinder- und Jugendhilfezentren im Kanton Zürich eine einheitliche, regional und kommunal solide abgestützte Leistungserbringung in den Bereichen Jugend- und Familienberatung, Erziehungsberatung, Mütter- und Väterberatung sowie im Kindesschutz. Das kjz Winterthur bietet Studierenden der Psychologie (Bachelor oder Master) an einer Schweizer Fachhochschule oder Universität ab dem 1. Februar 2027 ein sechsmonatiges Praktikum an. Im Rahmen des Praktikums erhalten Sie Einblick in folgende Tätigkeiten:
• Teilnahme an Familiengesprächen von verschiedenen PsychologInnen in prozessorientierter, systemisch ausgerichteter Erziehungsberatung im Auftrag der Eltern
• Co-Beratung sowie selbstständige Beratung und Begleitung von Eltern, Familien und Bezugspersonen mit Kindern und Jugendlichen bis 18 Jahren im freiwilligen Rahmen
• Fallbezogene administrative Aufgaben (Aktennotizen und fallbezogene Korrespondenz)
• Einblick in die Arbeit einer Kindesschutzabklärung im Auftrag der KESB über Fallbesprechungen mit den Abklärenden Sie haben die Gelegenheit das vielfältige Angebot der Erziehungsberatung im kjz Winterthur kennenzulernen und werden systematisch in unsere Aufgaben eingearbeitet. Es erwartet Sie eine lebendige, abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einer Institution, in der interdisziplinär und vernetzt mit anderen Bereichen der Gesamtinstitution zusammengearbeitet wird. Die Anstellungsbedingungen entsprechen den kantonalen Richtlinien. Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung. La Scuola Professionale Bülach (BSB) è la scuola cantonale professionale nella regione aeroportuale di Zurigo Unterland. Come centro di competenza per CV e ingegneria elettrica, forniamo formazione di base a circa 1.300 commercianti aspiranti, nonché installatori elettrici, elettricisti di assemblaggio e polimeccanica di aeromobili. Nel Dipartimento di Economia, circa 25 insegnanti insegnano agli studenti dell'economia di tipo di maturità professionale così come i commercianti EFZ secondo BIVO 2023. A causa di un fallimento di un insegnante, all'inizio dell'anno scolastico 2026/27 (17 agosto 2026) stiamo cercando uno o due docenti per l'area di competenza di azione E (uso di tecnologie del mondo del lavoro digitale). I deputati dovrebbero correre fino alla fine del semestre, probabilmente fino alla fine dell'anno scolastico per determinate lezioni. L'opzione di rinnovo non è esclusa.
• Si insegna nelle classi HKB-E nel primo e secondo anno con quattro e due lezioni settimanali. Come parte dell'assegnazione professionale per i docenti, si lavora anche nel consiglio studentesco, per esempio nella creazione di certificati di prestazione. Le lezioni sono diffuse nei giorni feriali lunedì, martedì per le lezioni del primo anno e venerdì per le lezioni del secondo anno.
• Hai il diploma di insegnamento per l'insegnamento a tempo pieno o part-time nel soggetto IKA del PHZH o l'EHB o una formazione pedagogica equivalente o sono pronti a completarlo. Idealmente, si dispone di esperienza pratica dal business. Si può anche avere esperienza di insegnamento a livello secondario. Si avvicinano ad altre persone con apertura e apprezzamento, hanno alte capacità sociali e godere di trattare con i giovani studenti. Inoltre, si sono caratterizzati da flessibilità, auto-iniziativa e un metodo di lavoro indipendente. Sei una personalità comunicativa, aperta e consensuale e può rapidamente integrarsi in un team esistente. Le condizioni di lavoro si basano sull'ordinanza degli insegnanti delle scuole secondarie e professionali (MBVO) del Cantone di Zurigo. Durante il periodo di formazione, sarete accompagnati dal team management specializzato.

Canton of Zurich Education Directorate Vocational School Bülach Lecturer/r HKB-E 56 - 88% The Vocational School Bülach (BSB) is the cantonal vocational college in the airport region of Zurich Unterland. As a competence center for CV and electrical professions, we teach around 1,300 learners in basic education (all CV-C)
• Profiles, electrical installer, assembly electrician. In addition, aircraft polymechanics complete their basic school education at our vocational school and adults can continue their education or take up an apprenticeship in the areas of competence of the school. The Vocational School Bülach (BSB) is the cantonal vocational college in the airport region of Zurich Unterland. As a competence center for CV and electrical engineering, we provide basic training to around 1,300 aspiring merchants as well as electrical installers, assembly electricians and aircraft polymechanics. In the Department of Economics, around 25 teachers teach the learners of the vocational maturity type economy as well as the merchants EFZ according to BIVO 2023. Due to a failure of a teacher, at the beginning of the school year 2026/27 (17 August 2026) we are looking for one or two lecturers for the action competence area E (use of technologies of the digital working world). Deputies are expected to run until the end of the semester, possibly until the end of the school year for certain lessons. The option for renewal is not excluded.
• You teach in the HKB-E classes in the first and second year with four and two weekly lessons. As part of the professional assignment for lecturers, you also work in the student board, for example in the creation of performance certificates. The lessons are spread over the weekdays Monday, Tuesday for the classes in the first year and Friday for the classes in the second year.
• You have the teaching diploma for full-time or part-time teaching in the subject IKA of the PHZH or the EHB or an equivalent pedagogical training or are ready to complete it. Ideally, you have practical experience from business. You can also have teaching experience at secondary level II. They approach other people with openness and appreciation, have high social skills and enjoy dealing with young learners. Furthermore, you are characterized by flexibility, self-initiative and an independent working method. You are a communicative, open-minded and consensual personality and can quickly integrate into an existing team. The employment conditions are based on the secondary and vocational school teachers ordinance (MBVO) of the Canton of Zurich. During the training period, you will be accompanied by the specialist team management.
• We offer you modern IT equipment throughout the school building and space to realize your own ideas. Application Have we aroused your interest? Then we look forward to your complete application via our online portal until the 6th. August 2026. Information on employment can be provided by the Head of Department for Economic Affairs, Heidy Schümperlin, heidy.schuemperlin.koch@edu.zh.ch , +41 44 872 30 92.

Als Kompetenzzentrum für KV und Elektro unterrichten wir in der Grundbildung rund 1'300 angehende Kaufleute sowie Elektroinstallateur/innen, Montage-Elektriker/innen und Flugzeug-Polymechaniker/innen. August 2026) ein oder zwei Lehrbeauftragte für den Handlungskompetenzbereich E (Einsetzen von Technologien der digitalen Arbeitswelt). Die Stellvertretungen laufen voraussichtlich bis Ende des Semesters, möglicherweise für gewisse Lektionen auch bis Ende des Schuljahrs. Die Option für eine Verlängerung ist nicht ausgeschlossen.

Im Rahmen des beruflichen Auftrags für Lehrbeauftragte arbeiten Sie auch in der Fachschaft mit, beispielsweise bei der Erstellung von Leistungsnachweisen. Die Lektionen verteilen sich auf die Wochentage Montag, Dienstag für die Klassen im ersten Lehrjahr und Freitag für die Klassen im zweiten Lehrjahr.

Sie gehen mit Offenheit und Wertschätzung auf andere Menschen zu, verfügen über hohe Sozialkompetenz und haben Freude am Umgang mit jungen Lernenden. Des Weiteren zeichnen Sie sich durch Flexibilität, Eigeninitiative und eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise aus. Sie sind eine kommunikative, aufgeschlossene und konsensfähige Persönlichkeit und können sich rasch in ein bestehendes Team integrieren. Unser Angebot Die Anstellungsbedingungen richten sich nach der Mittelschul- und Berufsschullehrerverordnung (MBVO) des Kantons Zürich. Cantone di Zurigo Direzione di Giustizia e Affari Interni Prigioni e Reintegrazione Istituzioni di Prigioni Cantone di Educazione Sociale di Zurigo (FH/HF) 80 - 100% Prigione Imprigione e Reintegrazione (JuWe) è responsabile nell'ambito della Direzione di Giustizia e Affari Interni del Cantone di Zurigo per l'esecuzione di sanzioni e misure, nonché l'esecuzione di vari tipi di detenzione. Per i nostri 1.400 dipendenti da circa 40 professioni, la riuscita reintegrazione sociale di persone che hanno commesso crimini, la prevenzione della recidiva e la detenzione e la preparazione della partenza di persone senza un permesso di soggiorno valido sono di particolare importanza. La prigione Affoltern am Albis (GFA) è una delle istituzioni carcerarie del Cantone di Zurigo (VEZ) – uno dei sette dipartimenti principali della JuWe – ed è un'istituzione specializzata nell'esecuzione chiusa delle pene. Il GFA può ospitare circa 60 detenuti. Per rafforzare il nostro team, stiamo cercando persone impegnate, affidabili e responsabili. Questo è il vostro campo d'azione
• Si prende cura, si occupano e accompagnano le persone più istruite con esigenze particolari all'interno delle strutture quotidiane e agiscono come loro persona di riferimento
• Garantisci una routine quotidiana ordinata (ad esempio, assicurando igiene, cibo, ordine cellulare, cambio lavanderia, ecc.)
• Assicurare il rispetto e l'applicazione delle normative di sicurezza e di servizio e capire come identificare e gestire situazioni critiche
• Si assume compiti amministrativi come la scrittura di rapport, la gestione delle voci delle directory e gli eventi di documentazione
• Partecipate ai vasi interdisciplinari di scambio e alle visite somatiche e psichiatriche che vi portano con
• Formazione professionale completa nella pedagogia sociale (FH/HF) benefica nella cura psichiatrica forense
• Maturità, conflittuale e capacità di confronto con capacità relazionali molto buone
• Forte abilità di squadra
• Prontezza per metodi di lavoro interdisciplinari e apprendimento continuo Questa è la nostra offerta
• Ore lavorative regolamentate nel servizio turni diurni
• Si può aspettare un lavoro impegnativo, interessante e versatile, nonché un team sostenibile e solidale
• Dopo un'attenta conoscenza di questo ambiente di lavoro dinamico e straordinario, Approfittate di varie opportunità di formazione interna o esterna
• Il luogo di lavoro è ca. 5 minuti a piedi dalla stazione di Affoltern su Albis

Canton of Zurich Directorate of Justice and Home Affairs Prison Imprisonment and Reintegration Prison Institutions Canton of Zurich Social Education/Employee (FH/HF) 80 - 100% Prison Imprisonment and Reintegration (JuWe) is responsible as part of the Directorate of Justice and Home Affairs of the Canton of Zurich for the execution of penalties and measures as well as the execution of various types of detention. For our 1,400 employees from around 40 professions, the successful social reintegration of people who have committed crimes, the prevention of recidivism and the detention and preparation of the departure of persons without a valid residence permit are of particular importance. The prison Affoltern am Albis (GFA) is one of the prison institutions of the Canton of Zurich (VEZ) – one of seven main departments of the JuWe – and is an institution specialized in the closed execution of prison sentences. The GFA can accommodate about 60 detainees. In order to strengthen our team, we are looking for committed, reliable and responsible individuals. This is your field of action
• You look after, employ and accompany the most instructed persons with special needs within the daily structures and act as their reference person
• You ensure an orderly daily routine (e.g. ensuring hygiene, food, cell order, laundry change, etc.)
• Ensure compliance with and enforcement of safety and service regulations and understand how to identify and manage critical situations
• You take on administrative tasks such as writing rapports, managing directory entries and documenting events
• You participate in the interdisciplinary exchange vessels as well as in somatic and psychiatric visits that bring You with
• Completed vocational training in social pedagogy (FH/HF) beneficial in forensic psychiatric care
• Maturity, conflict- and confrontation-capable personality with very good relationship skills
• Strong team skills
• Readiness for interdisciplinary working methods and continuous learning This is our offer
• Regulated working hours in day shift service

Canton of Zurich Directorate of Justice and Home Affairs Prisons and Reintegration Zurich Employee/working company 80 - 100% Prison and Reintegration (JuWe) is part of the Directorate of Justice and Home Affairs of the Canton of Zurich and employs around 1,400 women and men with a wide range of professional profiles. JuWe is responsible for the execution of penalties and measures as well as the implementation of the various types of detention. For the employees of JuWe, the successful social reintegration of people who have committed crimes and the prevention of recidivism is of particular importance. The Zurich Prisons of Detention (UGZ) – one of eight main departments of JuWe – currently operates seven prisons for pre-trial and security detention. One of these prisons is the Limmattal Prison (GFL), which is located in the district building Dietikon and offers 121 places for detainees together with the Horgen Prison Department (GFH). • You acquire orders and ensure quality and safety standards
• You perform administrative tasks such as creating reports and assessments of detained persons
• You shape a culture in which the relationship with people in the prison system is designed and lived objectively, reflected, committed, respectful and consistently.
• You have completed vocational training
• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing as well as good oral knowledge of at least one other language
• Minimum age 25 years
• You understand how to consciously regulate the proximity and distance to incarcerated persons and are characterized by a high level of social competence and assertiveness.
• You are physically and mentally resilient and can combine day, holiday and weekend services with your other commitments.

Canton of Zurich Penal System and Reintegration Administrative Specialist (fixed-term until 31.12.2028) 50 - 80%

As part of the Department of Justice and Home Affairs of the Canton of Zurich, the Penal System and Reintegration (JuWe) is responsible for the execution of sentences and measures as well as the implementation of various types of detention. For our 1,400 employees across approximately 40 professions, the successful social reintegration of offenders, the prevention of recidivism, and the detention and preparation for the departure of persons without a valid residence permit are of particular importance. The staff of the remand prisons supports the main department management and leads internal and external projects. Furthermore, it is responsible for the Meilen training prison, which is used for internal training and further education. For the operational and administrative development of the training prison, we are looking for an initiative, committed, and independent person to strengthen our team.

Your scope of duties

- You support the introduction and implementation of internal training and further education
- You are responsible for setting up and introducing course administration
- You are responsible for scheduling, sending out invitations, coordinating appointments, and answering questions from employees and managers
- You act as a host for our course participants at the Meilen training prison
- You act as a deputy for the Facility Manager at the Meilen training prison
- You work in working groups and projects

What you bring with you

- You have a commercial education and ideally experience in training or course administration
- You work independently and are committed
- You have a practical mindset; you can change a light bulb or escort a stray lizard out of the building
- You are flexible in terms of time and can, for example, cover holiday replacements
- Your German is stylistically confident and you are familiar with common IT standards
- For working with us, you need a clean criminal record

What makes this position special

- Your workplace is at the Meilen training prison – with the train station and Lake Zurich within walking distance
- You have a lot of creative freedom for the implementation of your assignment
- Your task is demanding and exciting, and you can count on a committed team
- Benefit from attractive further education offers
- Employment conditions are based on cantonal guidelines

Take the next step in your professional career with us and send us your application via our online tool. We look forward to your dossier.

Contact

The cantonal tax office together with the municipal tax offices collects taxes for the federal government, the canton and the municipalities. We support private individuals and companies throughout the tax collection process. Around 800 qualified employees are involved in this process at the site in Zurich Altstetten. In the withholding tax department, we ensure that taxed persons subject to source tax are correctly taxed and the corresponding processes are handled reliably. Our team services and support is the central point of contact for written and telephone requests from employers, representatives, employees and authorities. We also support important technical processes such as withholding tax assessment, reimbursements, certificates and the support of the online application eQuest. For this versatile team we are looking for a motivated personality as deputy team leader as of October 2026 or by appointment. For our 1,400 employees from around 40 professions, the successful social reintegration of people who have become guilty of criminal offences, the prevention of relapses, and the detention and preparation of the departure of persons without valid residence permits are of particular importance. The Bachtel prison centre (VZB) is one of the enforcement facilities of the canton of Zurich (VEZ) – one of seven main departments of the JuWe – and is an institution specialized in the open execution of imprisonment and replacement sentences. To strengthen the support and security service, we are looking for a flexible personality by immediately or by appointment. Tasks - Accompanying and caring for detained persons to prevent damage to their detention - Maintaining order and security for the detained persons, employees and third parties - Maintaining the health of the detained persons and accompanying them to external offices - Operation of the security centre and monitoring of the locking systems (inside and outside) as well as operation of the telephone control centre with overview and reliability - Reception of visitors and carrying out gift, effects and X-ray checks as well as trustful care of inmates and visitors, including the recognition and management of crisis situations - Careful completion of administrative tasks to support smooth operation - Interdisciplinary, cross-sectoral cooperation with employees working for the enforcement center Third parties

descriptionByLocale.fr: Description Canton de Zurich Direction de la justice et des affaires intérieures Institutions chargées de l'exécution de la justice et de la réintégration Zurich Service de soutien et de sécurité du personnel 80 - 100% Justice et réintégration (JuWe) est responsable de l'exécution des peines et des mesures dans le cadre de la Direction de la justice et des affaires intérieures du canton de Zurich et de l'exécution de divers types de détention. Pour nos 1400 employés d'une quarantaine de professions, la réinsertion sociale réussie des personnes qui se sont rendues coupables d'infractions pénales, la prévention des rechutes, la détention et la préparation du départ des personnes sans permis de séjour valide sont particulièrement importantes. Le centre pénitentiaire de Bachtel (VZB) est l'un des centres d'exécution du canton de Zurich (VEZ) – l'un des sept principaux départements du JuWe – et est une institution spécialisée dans l'exécution ouverte des peines de prison et de remplacement. Pour renforcer le service de soutien et de sécurité, nous recherchons une personnalité flexible immédiatement ou sur rendez-vous. Tâches - Accompagner et soigner les personnes détenues pour éviter qu'elles ne soient endommagées - Maintien de l'ordre et de la sécurité des personnes détenues, des employés et des tiers - Maintien de la santé des personnes détenues et les accompagner dans des bureaux extérieurs - Fonctionnement du centre de sécurité et surveillance des systèmes de verrouillage (intérieur et extérieur) ainsi que de l'exploitation du centre de contrôle téléphonique avec vue d'ensemble et fiabilité - Réception des visiteurs et réalisation de contrôles des dons, des effets et des rayons X ainsi que des soins de confiance des détenus et les visiteurs, y compris la reconnaissance et la gestion des situations de crise - Achèvement minutieux des tâches administratives pour favoriser un fonctionnement sans heurt - Coopération interdisciplinaire et intersectorielle avec les employés travaillant pour le centre d'application de la loi. Certificat Aptitude, (spécial) maturité, certificat d'études secondaires ou équivalent; idéalement complété par plusieurs années d'expérience dans une fonction proche des soins - Traitement professionnel de la proximité et de la distance en contact avec les détenus; haute compétence sociale et forte affirmation - Vous êtes en bon état physique, mentalement résistant et changement d'heures de travail (équipe, nuit, week-end et services de vacances) sont compatibles avec vos autres obligations - Vous pouvez vous exprimer très bien dans l'écriture et verbalement en allemand et ont sur la connaissance dans d'autres langues. Vous pouvez gérer la gamme MS Office - vous avez au moins 25 ans et avez une réputation parfaite (pas d'inscriptions dans le casier judiciaire et le casier judiciaire) - ouverture en cas de goulots d'étranglement personnels également pour effectuer des missions transversales dans d'autres départements de la VZB Nous vous offrons - Une tâche passionnante et polyvalente avec responsabilité dans un environnement de travail spécial - Une formation structurée et soignée dans votre nouvelle activité - Un lieu de travail attrayant dans le magnifique Zurich Oberland - Conditions d'emploi équitables et transparentes selon les directives cantonales Contact Votre candidature Faites votre prochain pas de développement professionnel avec nous et envoyez-nous votre candidature via notre outil en ligne. Profilo -

Description Canton of Zurich Health Directorate Office of Health Specialist in company permits, 80 - 90% The Canton of Zurich Office of Health provides high-quality and economically viable healthcare in the canton of Zurich. It ensures complete medical treatment and care and promotes the health of the Zurich population. We are looking for an 80-90% specialist in company permits for the approvals & supervision department in the Office of Health by immediately or by agreement. Tasks - You will work on comprehensive and complex applications for approval and approval from various healthcare institutions such as hospitals, hospitals or medical practices. - You will also help to supervise health professionals and health institutions by, among other things, accompanying on-site inspections. - You will work closely with the Legal and Cantonal Department.
• Profile - We are looking for an initiative and a high-performance person who has gained several years of current professional experience as a long-term care professional (care home or Spitex). - In addition, you will have experience in the design of the service schedule and personnel planning, ideally complemented by knowledge of the RAI system (Resident Assessment Instrument). - You have a strong understanding of the Swiss health system and its education system and have a degree at tertiary level (A or B). - Ideally, you also have commercial experience. - Your strengths include a safe appearance and skill in oral and written communication. - You have a fast understanding, think connected and can tackle complex issues in a structured, solution-oriented and targeted manner. - You are being certified for an analytical, goal-oriented, efficient and structured way of working. - You are trustworthy and ready to provide an above-average service for our customers. Offer -
• We offer you an interesting and diverse activity in a dedicated team with attractive employment conditions. - Your work location is located in a central location near Zurich Central Station. Es stellt eine lückenlose medizinische Behandlung und Betreuung sicher und fördert die Gesundheit der Zürcher Bevölkerung. • Aufgaben Sie bearbeiten umfassende und komplexe Bewilligungs- und Zulassungsgesuche von verschiedenen Institutionen aus dem Gesundheitswesen wie beispielsweise Heime, Spitäler oder Arztpraxen. Zudem helfen Sie bei der Aufsicht über Gesundheitsfachpersonen und Gesundheitsinstitutionen mit, indem sie unter anderem Inspektionen vor Ort begleiten. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit der Abteilung Recht und dem Kantonsärztlichen Dienst zusammen. Ihnen wird eine analytische, zielorientierte, effiziente und strukturierte Arbeitsweise attestiert. Sie sind vertrauenswürdig und bereit, für unsere Kunden eine überdurchschnittliche Leistung zu erbringen. Angebot

Insieme a voi, come dipartimento di amministrazione digitale della Cancelleria di Stato, stiamo guidando la trasformazione digitale del Cantone di Zurigo in avanti. L'intelligenza artificiale (AI) offre un grande potenziale per sostenere efficacemente l'amministrazione e fornire i suoi servizi alla popolazione e alle aziende in modo efficiente, sicuro e appropriato. L'uso di AI può alleviare i dipendenti, semplificare i processi e aumentare la qualità dei servizi. Allo stesso tempo, sono necessarie chiare condizioni quadro, affidabilità e gestione responsabile dei dati, della sicurezza e delle questioni etiche. Nell'amministrazione e in particolare nell'Ufficio Informatica, nell'Ufficio Statistica e Dati, nell'Ufficio delle Risorse Umane e nel settore dell'amministrazione digitale, promuoviamo quindi l'uso sicuro, responsabile e a valore aggiunto dell'IA. Un componente importante è i servizi AI di base che forniscono ai dipendenti un supporto concreto nel lavoro quotidiano, ad esempio nelle trascrizioni, nell'elaborazione delle parole o nelle soluzioni chatbot. Sei pronto a sfruttare il potenziale dell'IA nel Cantone di Zurigo e quindi guidare la trasformazione digitale del Cantone di Zurigo? • Si porta una laurea completa o master in informatica aziendale, business, scienza dei dati, intelligenza artificiale o un programma di laurea comparabile.

Aiutate a plasmare la trasformazione digitale dell'amministrazione e contribuire al beneficio per la popolazione e l'economia, che è al centro di tutte le nostre attività.
